doc: The toy second target of I47: a two-counter machine whose upstream repository holds its facts document. It runs through the same factory as the development target, with no edit to holon/. Its facts document's target.commit is zeros: the document is the upstream's own content, and the upstream commit that holds it is upstream.pinned_commit.
name: abacus

upstream.url_doc: no public upstream: `holon drift --target abacus --remote URL` names one (the I47 tests build it with tests_m4/_i47.upstream_repo)
